Why Foaps

Built different, on purpose.

Every product we build starts with one question: what do Global business owners actually need?

🚫

No hidden charges

What you see is what you pay. No per-order cuts, no surprise invoices, no fine print. Every Foaps product has transparent, flat pricing.

🛫

Built from India for the world

Global-first payments, WhatsApp as the primary channel, and support for diverse needs — we build for how global businesses actually operate.

⚡

Up and running in hours

No 6-week implementation cycles. Connect your accounts, set up your profile, and start taking orders the same day. Onboarding is part of the product.

🔗

Products that work together

Use Receiver for delivery orders, Orderpipe for direct orders, and Engage to bring customers back. One ecosystem, one dashboard.

📞

Real human support

WhatsApp support that actually responds. For critical issues, call us. We don't hide behind ticket queues — we pick up.

📈

Grows with you

Start with one product. Add more as your business scales. Foaps grows alongside you — from your first outlet to your tenth.
